sol.section: §8.5 Objective input binding; inherited §§10–10.1 default launch-estimate contract

steps.claim: Launch estimates support every well-typed resolved argument vector, use §11 defaults when no embedded schedule matches, and return an explicit effective schedule even for a default-only realisation.
steps.by: clause:ISA 0.9 §10.1 Resolved request and Certificate binding, inherited by the proposed full-version publication

steps.claim: The new rule requires ModelInputs in schedule.bindings whenever the target objective has model-resource terms. Missing required inputs permit no completed concrete schedule. The only new input transport is a setter on bennett_sched_request_t; bennett_estimate_run has no such input, and no default-estimate exception is stated.

Use the worked resolved surface target with objective weighted model_cycle:1 and selector {model:"surface",node:"algorithm",metric:"duration"}. Request an otherwise supported launch estimate with no matching embedded schedule. Its operational fields are concrete, but the launch request cannot supply the required ModelInput. Legal explicit N=1 and N=3 inputs would select respectively 3/100000000 and 9/100000000 seconds.

The inherited obligation requires a default-schedule estimate, while the new binding rule prohibits completing that schedule without an input this request cannot carry. Returning incomplete-model-objective and returning the required default estimate are conflicting obligations. This needs a semantic request/default decision, beyond C-header enumeration.

sol.fix: In §10.1 add: “A launch 0.10 estimate request additionally carries model_inputs JCS bytes governed by §8.5. The implementation MUST copy and validate them. A default-only effective schedule MUST serialize exactly those inputs in bindings.model_inputs. An embedded schedule is applicable only when its ModelInputs also match the request after JCS. Every complete, well-typed resolved request, including its required ModelInputs, MUST be supported. Missing required ModelInputs produce incomplete-model-objective before an estimate is returned; no parameter or reservation is inferred.” Expose these bytes through a versioned launch-estimate request or bennett_estimate_run_with_model_inputs, and update §10.1's completeness statement accordingly. Add vectors: supplied N=3 → model objective 9/100000000 seconds and a schedule hash covering that input; supplied N=1 → 3/100000000 and a distinct hash; missing required input → incomplete-model-objective; conflicting embedded input → use a correctly bound default schedule. Alternatively, explicitly exempt non-optimizing §10.1 scheduled-leaf estimates from the ModelInput requirement, retaining their complete §8.2 rows and checked certificate while leaving model objectives unresolved. I recommend explicit launch input transport. The ordinary scalar 0.9 API and its required demo estimates remain unchanged.
